subtopics.name: Arrays
subtopics.description: An array is a collection of items stored at contiguous memory locations.

subtopics.name: Linked List
subtopics.description: A linked list is a linear data structure where each element points to the next.

subtopics.name: Stacks
subtopics.description: A stack is a linear data structure which follows the LIFO (Last In First Out) principle.

subtopics.name: Queues
subtopics.description: A queue is a linear structure which follows the FIFO (First In First Out) principle.

subtopics.name: Sorting
subtopics.description: Sorting algorithms arrange elements in a particular order. Examples include bubble sort, merge sort, and quick sort.

subtopics.name: Searching
subtopics.description: Searching algorithms help find an element in a dataset. Examples are binary search and linear search.

subtopics.name: Derivatives
subtopics.description: A derivative represents the rate at which a function is changing at any given point.

subtopics.name: Integrals
subtopics.description: An integral calculates the area under a curve and is the inverse of a derivative.

subtopics.name: Linear Equations
subtopics.description: Linear equations are equations of the first order. Their graphs are straight lines.

subtopics.name: Quadratic Equations
subtopics.description: Quadratic equations are polynomial equations of degree 2 and can be solved using the quadratic formula.
